verdict.rationale: Graphite serves an llms.txt and per-page markdown mirrors at /docs/llms.txt and /docs/*.md, giving agents machine-readable docs, and also documents an official MCP server (gt-mcp). However, the root-level https://graphite.com/llms.txt returns a soft-404, and the served llms.txt links point to a mintlify preview domain rather than canonical graphite.com URLs, which are real friction points for an agent naively pointing at the standard location. Missing for 10: a working root-level llms.txt, corrected canonical links in the llms.txt index, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of agent usability.
